reason: One WebSearch on the 11-05/11-06 chip selloff returned only older or undated coverage, so this rests mostly on the packet and the tape. Four of five legs (NVDA, AVGO, AMD, MU) already stopped out at -20% to -24% and are cash; only MSFT (+5.8%, stops intact) remains. Re-buying semis at the 11-09 close after the worst week, with no confirmation the selloff has stabilised, would pay churn costs and risk another stop. Sitting mostly in cash at 4% APY while the trend repairs beats guessing the bottom. I will revisit when chips show relative strength.
